name: io.github.FOXOKO-LABS-LTD/dontaskagain-mcp
title: Don't Ask Again
description: Agent asks, human signs: wallet requests for AI agents, end-to-end encrypted, keys stay in browser

environmentVariables.name: DAA_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to the connection file from the wallet (KEY=VALUE lines with the DAA_* variables below, mode 600). Recommended: keeps the token and pairing code out of the command line.

environmentVariables.name: DAA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Signer address (https; plain http only for localhost or a private network). Required unless set in DAA_CONFIG.

environmentVariables.name: DAA_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Agent token aw_ag_<id>_<secret> from the wallet's connect wizard. Required unless set in DAA_CONFIG.

environmentVariables.name: DAA_WALLET
environmentVariables.description: Wallet public key <sig>.<kex> (base64url), pinned at the first start.

environmentVariables.name: DAA_WALLET_ID
environmentVariables.description: Wallet id wal_..., pinned at once (recommended).

environmentVariables.name: DAA_PAIR
environmentVariables.description: One-time pairing code (valid 24 h); can be removed after pairing.

environmentVariables.name: DAA_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Folder for the agent key and state (default ~/.dontaskagain).
